Ford Machine:

My hand out the window of the Ford machine, which to me now seems like a spaceship

The wind is so soft, as if I'm petting Sir Brigglesworth

He who has the coat of a kitten, in this his eighth cycle

I try to hold the smudges of clouds on the first overcast

But I hop from bright red candy apples, girls

with tans in bathing suits, intoxication, the smell of suntan lotion

I try to hold them all with equanimity

A straight horizontal line

Like the overcast, sun diffusing in all directions

Baltimore Rain

We like the master who knows

How the Fibonacci spirals around Lorentz

The taste of the coffee from the insider firm

He who knows the bioavailibility of the multivitamin

The lawyer who posses our lives more than we

The ___________ who 10,000 babydolls a year

A scientist who knows

The rain to fall on Baltimore

As if a greater historical legend were ever to exist

But what about the hunched, twisty woman with the

fishtail glasses who mystically weaves in

years of psycho-educative verbiage and southern speak?

What about her?

What do we rate her paper-shuffling skills?

Turkey and Giblets

Good things are good

Bad things are bad

But what if good things are bad?

And famine sweeps across the waters?

Average is a disappointing "awww"

To be average is to think "hmm?"

Yet celebrated in dead sea scrolls

And gallop polls

We are self-entitled

Apt from "broadcast programming"

Abstractions from the quivers

So we hold nothing

Don't go into the cat food isle when you're hungry

You'll want the turkey and giblets

Raisin Brain

Turn around don't drown

Turning grey

 Eating elephant one spoonful at a time
 Drink from firehoses
 Come inside to stormy weather

Little raisin brain

Suck out the hippocampi

Whose your God now?

Polar Questions

Those who devote to one thing

Never have any faith in it

Those who are the most skeptical

See the truth in everything

Those who live richly

Have no things

Originality respects something

A colony is purposeless

The trials of its individuals are true

A self-relating system

Relates to nothing

It exists in the middle

Polar questions are cold

If the Bible were sheer heavenly touch

It would be the veil of evil

When something wise is said

Opposites are pulled apart to their shared components

What is most obvious goes unnoticed
